_comment: Curated manifest. Only repositories listed here appear on the website; the scheduled workflow refreshes their public metadata (stars, last push, language) but never adds repositories.

projects.name: PMOO — parallel multi-objective optimisation
projects.description: Serial, OpenMP, CUDA and hybrid CPU–GPU implementations of NSGA-II, SPEA2 and MOEA/D, benchmarked on ZDT/DTLZ problems and a physics-based heat-conduction problem. The package ships both code states that produced the measurements, every per-run metric CSV, and a single analysis pipeline that generates every table, figure and number of the paper.
projects.contribution: The original PMOO library was created by Kamil Banach and Sebastian Pietras. Mohammed extended it with the heat-conduction problem, MOEA/D thread-safety fixes and the reproducibility pipeline.
projects.paper: On single-node parallelization strategies for efficient multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (under review)

projects.name: S175 ship-performance surrogate
projects.description: Neural surrogate of the S175 WeatherRouting ship-performance simulator: nine operating and environmental inputs map to ten speed, fuel and seakeeping outputs. Two feasibility classifiers handle the simulator's infeasible regions, and a per-output asymmetric loss biases errors toward the conservative side. Trained on 126,153,720 simulator evaluations within the ERA-NET MarTERA ROUTING project.
projects.contribution: First-author project; the WeatherRouting simulator is by R. Vettor, P. Krata and A. Kniat and is not part of the repository.
projects.paper: Data-driven machine learning surrogate model for the S175 ship performance prediction (under review)

projects.name: HPC for ship weather routing — systematic review
projects.description: Reproducibility package for a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of high-performance computing in multi-objective ship weather routing: protocol, executed queries per database, deduplication logs, screening decisions, extraction tables, evidence matrix and keyword maps, all generated by scripts.
projects.contribution: First-author project with P. Czarnul and J. Szłapczyńska.
projects.paper: Review of HPC-based multi-objective optimization for ship weather routing: current experiences, challenges, and future directions (under review)

projects.name: Sudanese Arabic harmful-language detection
projects.status: Accepted subject to revision — IAENG IJCS
projects.description: End-to-end pipeline for Sudanese Arabic harmful-language detection: text normalisation and de-duplication, weak-supervision label aggregation, transformer, BiLSTM, distillation and multi-task models, validation-only model selection, statistical evaluation and SHAP/LIME explanations. The corpus is released as hashed identifiers and labels, not texts.

projects.name: Sudanese dialect identification: BERT vs LLMs
projects.description: Experiment code comparing fine-tuned Arabic BERT models with zero- and few-shot large language models for Sudanese Arabic dialect identification, in binary and 18-dialect settings on the QADI and NADI corpora.

projects.name: MSF-CBERT — multi-source event classification
projects.description: Multi-source fusion for attack-type classification on the Global Terrorism Database: a ConfliBERT encoder over event narratives, verbalised categorical attributes and a gated dense branch over numeric attributes, with an optional inductive event graph. Includes group-disjoint and chronological splits and leakage-audit tests.

projects.name: Heterogeneous data fusion for event attribution
projects.description: Multi-modal preprocessing of the Global Terrorism Database (geocoding, Bayesian and distribution-aware imputation, redundancy analysis), silver-standard named-entity recognition and fine-tuned attribution classifiers, with robustness, generalisation and efficiency analyses.
projects.paper: Intelligent fusion of heterogeneous data for armed group recognition and attack attribution using the Global Terrorism Database (under review)

s175_speed.title: S175 surrogate vs. physical simulator: time per evaluation
s175_speed.source: Public repository MOHAMMED-ABDALSALAM-PG/S175-ML-surrogate, README “Headline results” (results/simulator_timing.json, results/evaluation/same_inputs_timing.json). Same workstation; simulator on CPU, surrogate on GPU.
